definitions.bones: All loaded actual GLB bone transforms and actual SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition world vertices; no authored controller samples are used.
definitions.physicalSpans: Only eight anatomical limb spans: UpperArm->Forearm, Forearm->Hand, Thigh->Shin, Shin->Foot on each side. Parallel bones and spine helper origins are deliberately excluded from length tests.
definitions.palm: Fixed actual hand skin patch using >0.7 Hand weight, central15%-55% hand length along source Snow finger axis, deepest4mm palmar surface. Exactly the prior audit definition.
definitions.elbow: Fixed rest vertices with summed arm weights>0.5 and within8cm of the Forearm world origin; deformed every sample.
definitions.shoe: Actual Coach_Sneakers/Soles/Shoe_Details meshes with >0.7 corresponding Foot weight.
definitions.nearPalm: Patch minY is between rendered floor minus1mm and authored contact layer0.006m plus0.005m. Pure geometry; no contact forces, load, COM or handLocked states inferred.
definitions.stability: World-space excursion of one fixed skinned palmar patch centroid and wrist origin per cyclic geometric near-contact run. Pivot/rock can move a patch centroid, so excursion is not itself proof of sliding.
definitions.torso: Hip and shoulder axes are left-minus-right actual Thigh/UpperArm origins. Axis separation is unsigned3D angle; horizontal difference is signed X/Z projected yaw. Chest lift is shoulder midpoint/torso-origin Y minus pelvis Y, not a biomechanical chest angle.
definitions.attachment: Torso-local offsets = inverse(actual torso world quaternion) * (actual shoulder/neck/head world origin minus actual torso world origin), compared at the same normalized phase. This removes intended rigid tilt/translation. Shoulder width and shoulder-to-head distances are independent rigid invariants.
definitions.bodyShift: Reported pelvis/torso displacement from R14 is total world-position change, including intended rigid wrist-pivot tilt and any reach translation. It is not the isolated authoring contactTranslation control value.
definitions.step: Adjacent actual GLB samples separated by1/1080 normalized cycle; report displacement, actual-second velocity and normalized-cycle velocity. Handoff screening windows are within10% of phase0/.5; near-straight elbow subset has elbow-to-shoulder/wrist-line height<=5mm. No leg-speed flag is applied.
definitions.collision: Wrist and actual palm-patch centroid to thigh/shin bone segments are broad-phase distances only. <7cm requests further mesh/visual review; it does not prove a mesh collision.
definitions.threshold: Engineering regression tolerances: seam0.01mm/0.01deg, extra physical span range1mm, new/deeper stage penetration1mm, extra near-contact patch excursion1cm. Not human performance standards.

limitations: 1081 discrete samples include baked keyframe midpoints but are not a continuous-time collision proof.
Only documented hand/palm/shoe/elbow skin selections are checked; full body collision and cloth intersections are not certified.
Same normalized phase can represent a different event after retiming; phase-local differences are not automatically regressions.
No mass/force model or realism score. Numeric clearance does not replace visual review or user acceptance.
Source assets, frozen R14 and candidate GLBs are read-only; only new review reports are written.
